steps.question: What co-expression modules do the filtered genes form across the 120 whole-blood samples, and which module eigengenes correlate with case versus control status?

grounding.reason: Co-expression modules: signed WGCNA network on VST matrix, soft threshold by scale-free fit, eigengenes against traits, hubs by module membership (rule R-0139)

steps.description: On the VST-transformed, filterByExpr-retained gene matrix (120 samples), build a signed weighted gene co-expression network with WGCNA. Choose the soft-threshold power as the lowest power reaching a scale-free topology fit index of about 0.8, report the power and the fit. Compute the topological overlap matrix, cluster genes by 1-TOM dissimilarity, cut the dendrogram with dynamic tree cut (minModuleSize=30), and merge modules whose eigengenes correlate above the merge cut height (0.25). Compute one module eigengene per module per sample, correlate each eigengene against the case/control binary trait across all 120 samples, and compute Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-values across all module x trait tests. Rank genes within each module by module membership (kME, correlation of the gene's expression with its module eigengene) to identify hub genes.
acceptance_criteria: soft-threshold power selected with scale-free fit >=0.8 and reported alongside mean connectivity
modules identified via dynamic tree cut with sizes reported (min size 30, merge height 0.25)
one eigengene per module correlated against case/control trait with raw and BH-adjusted p-values
top hub genes (by kME) listed per module
full gene-to-module assignment table produced

plan.title: Whole-blood case/control WGCNA co-expression modules
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is 120 whole-blood bulk RNA-seq samples (60 case, 60 control), raw gene-level Salmon counts across 12,000 genes, single batch, unpaired. The research question asks which co-expression modules the genes form and which modules track case/control status — a WGCNA-style question, not a supervised differential-expression question. The plan: (1) QC the sample structure on a variance-stabilized matrix to confirm the case/control split is not confounded by an outlier or an unrecognized structure; (2) filter low-count genes with edgeR's filterByExpr so the network is built on genes with real signal; (3) build a signed weighted co-expression network with WGCNA on the VST matrix — pick the soft-threshold power by the scale-free topology fit, cut modules by dynamic tree cut on the TOM dissimilarity, merge close eigengenes, and correlate every module eigengene against the case/control trait (and library-size covariates) to find which modules track the phenotype; (4) rank hub genes per module by module membership (kME) and run over-representation analysis against curated human pathway sets for the case-associated modules, to give the modules biological names; (5) assemble a single report stating sample/gene counts, the network parameters, the module table, and the eigengene-trait correlations with adjusted p-values, explicit that a module is a correlated gene set, not a validated pathway.
